comment: Container images used to capture the command output that appears in the
linux-plus notes. Pinned by digest per architecture, so a transcript can be
reproduced later and 'verified on' in a topic is a checkable claim rather
Digests are per architecture because most registries report an
architecture-specific digest rather than the manifest list digest, and
running amd64 on an arm64 host silently falls back without one.
These cover the package-manager and userland split the exam tests. They do
not cover anything needing a real kernel, boot, block devices, or hardware;
output for those is sourced from documentation and labelled as such.

alma.label: AlmaLinux 10.2
alma.note: Stands in for the RHEL family: dnf, rpm, SELinux userspace.

debian.label: Debian 13 (trixie)
debian.note: Debian is not Ubuntu. Objective 1.4 tests exactly that gap.

ubuntu.label: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS
ubuntu.note: netplan and ufw live here, not on Debian.

suse.label: openSUSE Leap 16.0
suse.note: SLES is on CompTIA's recommended distribution list and zypper is a third package manager.
